# Money Resilience Utility

Money Resilience is a free, registration-free household financial stress-test utility.
It helps users explore how changes in prices, exchange rates, interest rates and cash buffers may affect household resilience.
It does not provide investment, tax, legal or financial-product advice.

## Main pages
- / — Money Resilience Utility
- /guides/ — Guides
- /inflation/ — Inflation and household budgets
- /yen/ — Yen depreciation and household exposure
- /cash-buffer/ — Household cash buffer
- /overseas-payment/ — Overseas payment costs
- /methodology.html — Methodology and stress-test approach
- /sources.html — Public reference sources
- /faq.html — Frequently asked questions
- /privacy.html — Privacy
- /terms.html — Usage notes and limitations
- /about.html — About and disclaimer
- /media.html — Information for editors and organizations

The utility score is an internal comparison indicator, not a credit score, lending decision, investment rating, or forecast.
Household diagnostic inputs are designed to be calculated in the browser.
